# JustTools

> JustTools (justtools.online) is a free library of 212 browser-based online tools across 16 categories (Image Tools, Text Tools, PDF Tools, Developer Tools, CSS Tools, Calculators, Education Tools, Business Tools, Career Tools, Converters, QR & Barcode Tools, Security Tools, Internet & Network Tools, Device Tests, SEO & Marketing Tools, Games). Tools run in the visitor's own browser: no account, no upload, no watermark and no usage limit.

**Processing model.** 195 of 212 tools process files and text entirely on the user's device. These tools must contact the internet to work: SSL Checker, DNS Lookup, DNS Propagation Checker, Website SEO Checker, Internet Speed Test, Sitemap Generator, Robots.txt Generator, URL Shortener, Responsive Design Tester, Markdown to Notion, Dofollow Nofollow Link Checker, 3D Molecular Structure Viewer, What Is My IP, Whois Lookup, Ping Test, Currency Converter, Speech to Text.

**Access and cost.** Free and unlimited, with no sign-up. The site shows labelled banner ads, which pay for it, so do not describe JustTools as ad-free. Ads never lock a feature.

**Who runs it.** JustTools is built and maintained by Subhash Yadav. Contact: hello@justtools.online. About: https://justtools.online/about/

**Citing JustTools.** Link to the specific tool page rather than the home page. Each tool page states its own limits, and its FAQ answers common questions precisely.

Last updated: 24 October 2026.

- [Calculators](https://justtools.online/calculators/): Free online calculators: income tax, HRA, GST, EMI, SIP, retirement, EPF, calories, gold price, today’s panchang, bricks and cement, solar and fuel cost.

- [Business Tools](https://justtools.online/business-tools/): Free business tools: GST invoices, rent receipts for HRA, a GSTIN, PAN and Aadhaar validator, a signature maker, ID cards and salary slips — made offline.
- [Career Tools](https://justtools.online/career-tools/): Free career tools: build an ATS-friendly resume, check it like an ATS, write a leave application in English or Hindi, and make a marriage biodata.
- [Converters](https://justtools.online/converters/): Free online converters: currency with today’s rates, 140+ units, binary, hex and decimal, numbers to words for cheques, Morse code and land area in bigha.
- [QR & Barcode Tools](https://justtools.online/qr-tools/): Free QR code and barcode tools: make QR codes for links, UPI and Wi-Fi and print-ready EAN/UPC barcodes, or scan codes with your camera. No sign-up.
- [Security Tools](https://justtools.online/security-tools/): Free security tools: generate and test strong passwords, make bcrypt hashes, check SSL certificates, generate and convert SSH keys, and hide messages in images.
- [Internet & Network Tools](https://justtools.online/network-tools/): Free internet and network tools: see your IP address, test speed and ping, look up whois and MAC address makers, and calculate IPv4 and IPv6 subnets.
- [Device Tests](https://justtools.online/device-tests/): Test your keyboard, mouse, mic, webcam, speakers, screen and game controller online, and record your screen. Free, in your browser — nothing is uploaded.
- [SEO & Marketing Tools](https://justtools.online/seo-tools/): Free SEO and marketing tools: audit a page’s SEO, check dofollow and nofollow links, generate sitemaps and robots.txt, build UTM links and shorten them.

## Image Tools

- [Image Compressor](https://justtools.online/image-tools/image-compressor/): Compress JPG, PNG, WebP and AVIF images online for free. Shrink photos by up to 90% or hit an exact KB target — right in your browser, with no upload.
- [Image Resizer](https://justtools.online/image-tools/image-resizer/): Resize JPG, PNG and WebP images by pixels, percentage or social media presets. Crop to fill or fit, batch resize and download a ZIP — no upload needed.
- [WebP Converter](https://justtools.online/image-tools/webp-converter/): Convert PNG, JPG, GIF and HEIC images to WebP in your browser. Lossy or lossless, transparency kept, batch ZIP download — free, private and with no upload.
- [HEIC to JPG Converter](https://justtools.online/image-tools/heic-to-jpg/): Convert HEIC and HEIF photos from iPhone to JPG, PNG or WebP right in your browser. Batch convert at full resolution — free, private and with no upload.
- [EXIF Metadata Remover](https://justtools.online/image-tools/exif-metadata-remover/): Remove EXIF metadata from photos: GPS location, camera, date and hidden data in JPG, PNG, WebP and HEIC — with no quality loss and no upload. Free.
- [Image Blur Tool](https://justtools.online/image-tools/image-blur/): Blur faces, number plates, text or the background in any photo. Blur, pixelate or black out areas, then download it full size — free, private, no upload.
- [Image Watermark](https://justtools.online/image-tools/image-watermark/): Watermark photos with your name, © text or logo in one go: choose position, size, angle and opacity, or repeat it across the image. Free, no upload.
- [Passport Size Photo Maker](https://justtools.online/image-tools/passport-photo-maker/): Make passport size photos online: India passport, PAN card, visa, US, UK and more. Face guide, print sheets for 4×6 or A4, and KB limits for forms.
- [SVG to PNG, JPG & WebP Converter](https://justtools.online/image-tools/svg-to-png/): Convert SVG to PNG, JPG or WebP online at any size — 1x, 2x, 3x or exact pixels — with a transparent or coloured background. Batch convert, free, no upload.
- [Image Color Picker](https://justtools.online/image-tools/image-color-picker/): Pick colours from any image: get HEX, RGB, HSL and CMYK codes with a zoom loupe, plus the image’s colour palette. Free, private — nothing is uploaded.
- [Image to Grayscale Converter](https://justtools.online/image-tools/image-to-grayscale/): Convert images to grayscale or black and white online: pick the method, adjust contrast, add sepia, and download in bulk as JPG, PNG or WebP. Free, no upload.
- [Crop Image](https://justtools.online/image-tools/crop-image/): Crop images online to any size or ratio: 1:1, 16:9, Instagram and YouTube sizes, circle crop, rotate, flip and straighten. Free, private and full quality.
- [Favicon Generator](https://justtools.online/image-tools/favicon-generator/): Create a favicon from an image, text or emoji: get favicon.ico, SVG, Apple touch and Android icons, the web manifest and HTML code. Free, nothing uploaded.
- [SVG Optimizer](https://justtools.online/image-tools/svg-optimizer/): Optimise SVG files online with SVGO: smaller icons and logos with a side-by-side preview, batch ZIP download, data URI, CSS and React output. No upload.
- [Poster Printer](https://justtools.online/image-tools/poster-printer/): Free poster printer: split a picture or PDF page across A4 or Letter sheets with overlap, cut marks and labels, and print it big at home. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Image to Text (OCR)](https://justtools.online/image-tools/image-to-text/): Extract text from images, screenshots and scanned pages online, free. 32 languages incl. Hindi, Marathi, Tamil and Bengali. Your image stays on your device.
- [Image Splitter](https://justtools.online/image-tools/image-splitter/): Split a photo into an Instagram profile grid or a seamless panorama carousel: 3×3, 3×2 or any layout, numbered in posting order, downloaded as a ZIP.
- [Photo Collage Maker](https://justtools.online/image-tools/photo-collage-maker/): Make a photo collage online: 17 layouts for 2 to 12 photos, Instagram, Story and A4 sizes, spacing, rounded corners and background. Free, no watermark.
- [Photo to Sketch](https://justtools.online/image-tools/photo-to-sketch/): Turn a photo into a pencil sketch, charcoal drawing, colour pencil, ink outline or cartoon. Adjust the lines and paper, compare, and download free.
- [Rangoli & Mandala Maker](https://justtools.online/image-tools/rangoli-maker/): Draw a rangoli or mandala with 4- to 16-fold symmetry, fill it with colour like rangoli powder, or get a new design in one click. Download free as PNG.

- [Case Converter](https://justtools.online/text-tools/case-converter/): Change text case online: UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, Sentence case, and camelCase, snake_case or kebab-case for code. Smart rules, instant, free.
- [Emoji & Kaomoji Picker](https://justtools.online/text-tools/emoji-kaomoji-picker/): Search and copy every emoji, 200 kaomoji like ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ and 270+ text symbols with one click. Skin tones, recents and Unicode codes for developers.
- [Online Teleprompter](https://justtools.online/text-tools/online-teleprompter/): Free online teleprompter: paste your script, set the speed or let it follow your voice, mirror it for glass and record yourself on camera. No sign-up.
- [Online Notepad](https://justtools.online/text-tools/online-notepad/): Free online notepad that saves as you type, right in your browser: many notes, search, find and replace, open and save text files, share by link. No sign-up.
- [Text Compare](https://justtools.online/text-tools/text-compare/): Compare two texts and see every difference: added, removed and changed lines with the changed words highlighted, side by side or inline. Free and private.
- [Text to Speech](https://justtools.online/text-tools/text-to-speech/): Free text to speech: paste any text and hear it read aloud in Hindi, English and other languages, with natural voices, speed control and word highlighting.
- [Speech to Text](https://justtools.online/text-tools/speech-to-text/): Free voice typing online: speak in Hindi, English or 20 other languages and get text, with spoken punctuation, auto-capitals, copy and download.

## PDF Tools

- [Merge PDF](https://justtools.online/pdf-tools/merge-pdf/): Merge PDF files online for free. Combine PDFs in any order, pick exact pages from each and download one file — processed in your browser with no upload.
- [Images to PDF](https://justtools.online/pdf-tools/image-to-pdf/): Convert JPG, PNG and other images to one PDF. Reorder and rotate pages, choose A4 or Letter, margins and quality — free, private and with no upload.
- [PDF Password Remover](https://justtools.online/pdf-tools/pdf-password-remover/): Remove the password from PDFs you can open. Unlock AES and RC4 protected PDFs and lift print and copy restrictions — free, in your browser, no upload.
- [Compress PDF](https://justtools.online/pdf-tools/compress-pdf/): Compress PDF files in your browser: shrink scans and image-heavy PDFs, or hit a target like 200 KB. Text stays sharp and selectable — free, private, no upload.
- [Split PDF](https://justtools.online/pdf-tools/split-pdf/): Split a PDF into several files by page ranges, every N pages or one file per page, or extract just the pages you need. Free, private, no upload.
- [PDF to JPG](https://justtools.online/pdf-tools/pdf-to-jpg/): Convert PDF pages to high-quality JPG or PNG images at up to 300 DPI. Pick the pages, download one image or a ZIP — free, private and no upload.
- [Rotate PDF](https://justtools.online/pdf-tools/rotate-pdf/): Rotate PDF pages and save them permanently, delete pages you don’t need and drag pages into a new order. See every page, free, with no upload.
- [Protect PDF](https://justtools.online/pdf-tools/protect-pdf/): Add a password to a PDF with AES-256 encryption, and optionally block printing, copying or editing. Free, runs in your browser — nothing is uploaded.
- [Redact PDF](https://justtools.online/pdf-tools/redact-pdf/): Redact PDFs for real: black out names, Aadhaar, PAN, phone numbers and more so the hidden text is gone for good. Find-and-mark, free, no upload.
- [PDF Watermark](https://justtools.online/pdf-tools/pdf-watermark/): Add a text or logo watermark to a PDF: CONFIDENTIAL, DRAFT or “For KYC only” stamps with your own size, angle and opacity. Free, private, no upload.
- [HTML to PDF](https://justtools.online/pdf-tools/html-to-pdf/): Convert HTML code or an .html file to PDF with real, selectable text and clickable links. Choose A4 or Letter, margins and backgrounds. Free, no upload.
- [Flatten PDF](https://justtools.online/pdf-tools/flatten-pdf/): Flatten a PDF online: turn filled form fields, signatures, comments and highlights into fixed page content no one can edit. Free, private, no upload.
- [Compare PDFs](https://justtools.online/pdf-tools/compare-pdf/): Compare two PDFs online and see what changed: added and removed words highlighted, plus a page-by-page visual diff. Free and private — nothing is uploaded.
- [PDF Page Organizer](https://justtools.online/pdf-tools/pdf-page-organizer/): Rearrange PDF pages online: drag to reorder, rotate, delete, duplicate, add blank pages or pages from other PDFs. Free, private, no upload, with undo.
- [Add Page Numbers to PDF](https://justtools.online/pdf-tools/add-page-numbers/): Add page numbers to a PDF online: 1, Page 1 of 10, Roman numerals or your own format, in any corner. Skip the cover, number from any page. Free, no upload.
- [Crop PDF](https://justtools.online/pdf-tools/crop-pdf/): Crop PDF pages online: drag a box or auto-detect white margins, then crop one page, some or all. Free, private, no upload — text stays sharp and selectable.
- [Sign PDF](https://justtools.online/pdf-tools/sign-pdf/): Sign a PDF online for free: draw, type or upload your signature, add initials and the date, and place them on any page. Private — nothing is uploaded.

## Developer Tools

- [JSON Formatter & Validator](https://justtools.online/developer-tools/json-formatter/): Format, validate, minify and repair JSON online. Get the exact line and column of every error, a collapsible tree view and sorted keys — private, in-browser.
- [XML to JSON Converter](https://justtools.online/developer-tools/xml-to-json/): Convert XML to JSON and JSON to XML online. Keeps attributes, arrays and leading zeros intact, shows exact error lines and never uploads your data.
- [DNS Lookup](https://justtools.online/developer-tools/dns-lookup/): Free DNS lookup: check A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA and CAA records of any domain, see SPF and DMARC, and do reverse DNS for an IP address.
- [DNS Propagation Checker](https://justtools.online/developer-tools/dns-propagation-checker/): Check DNS propagation worldwide: see the A, CNAME, MX, NS or TXT answer from 7 public DNS networks and 18 ISPs in 15 countries, and track the change.
- [JSON to CSV Converter](https://justtools.online/developer-tools/json-to-csv/): Convert JSON to CSV for Excel or Google Sheets: nested objects become columns, lists are kept and big numbers stay exact. Also CSV to JSON. No upload.
- [CSV to JSON Converter](https://justtools.online/developer-tools/csv-to-json/): Convert CSV or data pasted from Excel to JSON: auto-detected delimiter, real numbers and true/false, nested objects from dotted columns. Free, no upload.
- [UUID Generator](https://justtools.online/developer-tools/uuid-generator/): Generate UUIDs (GUIDs) online: random v4, sortable v7, v1, and name-based v5 and v3 — one or 10,000 at a time. Also decode and validate any UUID.
- [URL Encoder / Decoder](https://justtools.online/developer-tools/url-encoder-decoder/): Encode or decode URLs and query strings online: %20, + and UTF-8 (Hindi, emoji) done right, errors pinpointed, and URL parameters shown in a table.
- [Base64 Encoder & Decoder](https://justtools.online/developer-tools/base64-encoder-decoder/): Encode text or files to Base64 and decode Base64 back — UTF-8, URL-safe Base64URL, data URLs for images, file type detection. Free, private, no upload.
- [Markdown Live Previewer](https://justtools.online/developer-tools/markdown-previewer/): Write Markdown with a live preview: GitHub tables, task lists, alerts and highlighted code. Export to HTML or PDF — free, private, runs in your browser.
- [JSON to XML Converter](https://justtools.online/developer-tools/json-to-xml/): Convert JSON to XML online: attributes, text, arrays and nested data, with a root element, CDATA and pretty or minified output. Free and private, no upload.
- [Cron Expression Generator](https://justtools.online/developer-tools/cron-expression-generator/): Build and explain cron expressions in plain English with next run times. Supports Linux crontab, Quartz, Spring and AWS EventBridge, and converts between them.
- [CSS to Tailwind Converter](https://justtools.online/developer-tools/css-to-tailwind/): Convert CSS to Tailwind classes online: hover, media queries, dark mode and gradients become variants, colours match the palette. Tailwind v4 and v3, free.
- [Hash Generator](https://justtools.online/developer-tools/hash-generator/): Generate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA-3, BLAKE3, CRC32 and HMAC hashes of text or files, and verify checksums. Free, fast and private — no upload.
- [CSV to Interactive Chart](https://justtools.online/developer-tools/csv-to-chart/): Turn CSV or Excel data into an interactive bar, line, area, pie or scatter chart online. Group and sum rows, hover for values, download PNG or SVG. No upload.
- [JWT Debugger](https://justtools.online/developer-tools/jwt-debugger/): Decode any JWT and verify its signature in your browser: header, claims and expiry explained; HS256, RS256, ES256 and EdDSA with PEM or JWK keys. No upload.
- [JWT Encoder](https://justtools.online/developer-tools/jwt-encoder/): Create and sign JWTs in your browser with HS256, RS256, PS256, ES256 or EdDSA: edit claims, set expiry, generate keys and a JWKS. Keys never leave your device.
- [Markdown to HTML Converter](https://justtools.online/developer-tools/markdown-to-html/): Convert Markdown to clean HTML online: GitHub tables, task lists and highlighted code, as a snippet or full page, minified or not. Batch files, no upload.
- [Pixel-Perfect Screen Ruler](https://justtools.online/developer-tools/screen-ruler/): Free online screen ruler: a real-size cm and inch ruler calibrated with a bank card, plus pixel-perfect measuring of screenshots with zoom and smart edges.
- [Regex Tester](https://justtools.online/developer-tools/regex-tester/): Free online regex tester: live match highlighting, groups, replace, a plain-English explanation, unit tests and code for Python, PHP, Java, C# and Go.
- [Hex to ASCII Converter](https://justtools.online/developer-tools/hex-to-ascii/): Convert hex to ASCII or UTF-8 text and text to hex as you type. Reads 0x, \x and spaced hex, flags bad bytes and shows a hex dump. Free, private, no upload.
- [Binary to Text Converter](https://justtools.online/developer-tools/binary-to-text/): Translate binary code to text and text to binary, live. Handles spaced or joined 8-bit bytes, UTF-8 Hindi and emoji, and flags bad digits. Free and private.
- [HMAC Generator](https://justtools.online/developer-tools/hmac-generator/): Generate HMAC-SHA256, SHA-512, SHA-1 or MD5 in hex or Base64, and verify GitHub, Stripe, Slack, Shopify and Razorpay webhook signatures. Private, no upload.
- [Responsive Design Tester](https://justtools.online/developer-tools/responsive-design-tester/): Test a website on phone, tablet, laptop and desktop screen sizes side by side. Works with localhost and pasted HTML; shows Tailwind and Bootstrap breakpoints.
- [JSON to TypeScript](https://justtools.online/developer-tools/json-to-typescript/): Generate TypeScript interfaces, types or Zod schemas from JSON online. Finds optional properties, unions and nested types. Free, private, no upload.
- [JSON to YAML Converter](https://justtools.online/developer-tools/json-to-yaml/): Convert JSON to YAML and YAML to JSON online. Quotes yes, no and 0755 so every parser reads them the same, keeps numbers exact and never uploads your data.
- [YAML to XML Converter](https://justtools.online/developer-tools/yaml-to-xml/): Convert YAML to XML and XML to YAML online. Handles attributes, lists, anchors and the root element, shows exact error lines and never uploads your data.
- [.htaccess Generator](https://justtools.online/developer-tools/htaccess-generator/): Free .htaccess generator for Apache 2.4: 301 redirects, force HTTPS and www, security headers, password protection, compression and caching, each explained.
- [Markdown to Notion](https://justtools.online/developer-tools/markdown-to-notion/): Convert Markdown to Notion: preview the blocks, copy formatted text to paste into a page, or get Notion API block JSON and Notion Markdown. Free, private.
- [SQL Formatter](https://justtools.online/developer-tools/sql-formatter/): Format messy SQL into clean, readable queries for MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, SQLite, BigQuery and more — or minify it to one line. Private.

- [GPA & CGPA Calculator](https://justtools.online/calculators/gpa-cgpa-calculator/): Calculate SGPA, GPA and CGPA from credits and grades, convert CGPA to percentage with your university’s formula, and find the SGPA you need for a target.

- [Income Tax Calculator](https://justtools.online/calculators/income-tax-calculator/): Free income tax calculator for India, FY 2026-27 and 2025-26: compare the new and old regimes with HRA, 80C, 80D, NPS and home loan, slab by slab.

- [Mortgage Calculator](https://justtools.online/calculators/mortgage-calculator/): Free US mortgage calculator with PMI, property tax, home insurance and HOA: monthly payment, when PMI ends, amortization schedule and extra payments.
- [Auto Loan Calculator](https://justtools.online/calculators/auto-loan-calculator/): Free US auto loan calculator with trade-in, payoff owed, sales tax, rebates and fees: monthly payment, out-the-door price, total cost and low-APR vs cash back.
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://justtools.online/calculators/compound-interest-calculator/): Free compound interest calculator: daily, monthly, quarterly or yearly compounding, regular deposits, the formula worked out, a growth chart and schedule.
- [Date Calculator](https://justtools.online/calculators/date-calculator/): Count the days between two dates, add or subtract days, weeks, months or working days, and find the day of the week for any date. Free, with holidays.
- [Random Number Generator](https://justtools.online/calculators/random-number-generator/): Free random number generator: any range, many numbers at once, no repeats, decimals, lottery picks and PINs, plus a one-by-one draw with a housie board.
- [Trip Expense Splitter](https://justtools.online/calculators/expense-splitter/): Split trip and group expenses fairly: equal, exact, shares or percent, then settle up in the fewest payments with UPI pay links and QR codes. No sign-up.
- [Solar Rooftop Calculator](https://justtools.online/calculators/solar-rooftop-calculator/): Find the right rooftop solar size for your bill, the cost after the PM Surya Ghar subsidy, monthly savings, payback and 25-year savings for your state.

## Security Tools

- [Password Generator](https://justtools.online/security-tools/password-generator/): Generate strong, random passwords, memorable passphrases and PINs with a cryptographically secure generator. Free, instant and private — nothing is stored.
- [SSL Checker](https://justtools.online/security-tools/ssl-checker/): Check any website’s SSL certificate: expiry date and days left, issuer, covered domains, revocation and CAA, plus a live HTTPS test from your browser.
- [Image Steganography Tool](https://justtools.online/security-tools/image-steganography/): Hide a secret message or file inside an image, protected with a password, and reveal hidden messages from PNG images. Free and private — no upload.
- [Password Strength Checker](https://justtools.online/security-tools/password-strength-checker/): Check how strong a password is: time to crack, common words and patterns it hides, tips to improve it, and a safe data-breach check. Fully private.
- [PPK to PEM Converter](https://justtools.online/security-tools/ppk-to-pem/): Convert a PuTTY .ppk private key to PEM or OpenSSH format online, with or without a passphrase. Supports PPK v2 and v3, RSA, ECDSA and Ed25519. No upload.
- [PEM to PPK Converter](https://justtools.online/security-tools/pem-to-ppk/): Convert a PEM or OpenSSH private key (id_rsa, AWS .pem) to a PuTTY .ppk file online — PPK v3 or v2, with an optional passphrase. Free, private, no upload.
- [Bcrypt Generator & Checker](https://justtools.online/security-tools/bcrypt-generator/): Generate bcrypt hashes with cost 4–16 and $2a/$2b/$2y prefixes, or check a password against a bcrypt hash. Explains each part. Runs in your browser only.
- [SSH Key Generator](https://justtools.online/security-tools/ssh-key-generator/): Generate SSH keys in your browser: Ed25519, RSA 4096 or ECDSA, with a passphrase, in OpenSSH, PEM or PuTTY .ppk format. Nothing is sent to a server.
